subject: Draft MAP & next steps — TideX POC timeline
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@tidex.ai>, Sophia Martinez <sophia.m@tidex.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP & next steps — TideX POC timeline

Hi Evan / Sophia —

Thanks again for the call this morning. I promised to send a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) capturing milestones, owners, and dependencies so we can align on an achievable POC timeline. Key notes from the call:

- Goal: 2-week sandbox POC to validate throughput and latency at pilot data volumes.
- Success criteria: <=150ms median token latency, integration with TideX ingestion pipeline, and preserved customer data controls.
- Risk: data retention policy and SOC2 evidence required before production rollout.

Attached is TDX-MAP-v0.9.xlsx — it's intentionally granular so we can iterate quickly. High-level milestones inside:
1) Kickoff & access (Owner: TideX) — target 3/10
2) Integration engineering (Owner: Redwood) — target 3/17
3) Performance validation + quantization check (Joint) — target 3/24
4) Security review (Owner: TideX) — target 3/26
5) Optional pilot extension (Joint) — target 4/2

Please review owners and dates and mark any constraints. My ask: can you confirm TideX access (S3 keys / service account) by 3/9 so we can start integration on Monday?

Also dropping a link to the HubSpot deal so we have a single source of truth: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/TDX-7843

Attachments: [Attachment: TDX-MAP-v0.9.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mobile: (555) 612-2024

Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & next steps — TideX POC timeline

Thanks Dylan — good recap. A few quick items from our side:

- Access: we can provide a short-lived S3 role by 3/9 but need the exact IAM policy you require. Can you send the minimum permissions?
- Security review: our security team wants a staging-only data retention policy and an exportability checklist before we commit to dates. They asked for SOC2-related evidence; I'll attach initial redlines.
- Timeline: 3/24 performance validation is tight given our internal calendar — can we make the joint validation window 3/24–3/30 instead?

I've attached TideX-redlines.docx with security comments and some procurement questions for Marcus (cc). Also flagged two dependencies: (a) a signed NDA/LoA and (b) confirmation on data deletion window.

Please update the MAP with these points and share an updated version next week.

Attached: [Attachment: TideX-redlines.docx (document)]

—Evan
Evan Liu

Evan — really helpful feedback, thanks. I've updated the MAP to reflect:
- IAM: added minimal policy snippet and explicit permission list on sheet "Access".
- Security: added a new milestone for "Security evidence packet" (Owner: TideX) with due 3/19; added data deletion window question.
- Timeline: extended performance validation to span 3/24–3/30 per your note.

Attached: TDX-MAP-v1.0.xlsx (see tab "Milestones" for owner matrix). Also linking the Drive folder with the MAP and test plan: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_map_folder

Next steps I propose:
- TideX confirms IAM policy by 3/9 (Evan)
- Redwood provides instrumented integration checklist by 3/11 (Marcus)
- TideX security packet due 3/19 (Sophia)

If these dates work I'll lock the MAP and we'll do weekly checkpoints. Marcus — can you drop the checklist by Thursday?
